deskyard remote add: save a desktop as a remote

Usage: deskyard [-d NAME] remote add NAME URL --token dyt_…

Checks the token against the desktop's agent API and saves the remote in
remotes.json ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/deskyard-desktop, default ~/.config/deskyard;
mode 0600). URL is the desktop's address, like https://host/alice. Tokens come
from the desktop's Agents tab. The first remote becomes the default.

Arguments:
  NAME       string      required  local name for the remote (letters, digits, . _ -)
  URL        string      required  the desktop's URL, e.g. https://host/alice

Options:
  --token TOKEN        agent token (dyt_…); defaults to $DESKYARD_TOKEN

Prints: a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard remote add alice https://desktops.example.com/alice --token dyt_…

Where: on this machine (no remote needed)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
